basis: renders a bare <div> of slotted row controls — no role asserted.

responsive.basis: the actions translate into view on hover/focus and sit permanently in view under pointer-coarse.

exceptions.because: the pointer media the pattern answers has no cross-engine witness: Playwright's emulateMedia carries no pointer feature, so the coarse-pointer reveal cannot be exercised outside a real device. The underlying translate-x-0/opacity-100 rules are visible in the source; the engine-scoped gap stands until Playwright ships pointer emulation.

interaction.basis: a row surface hosting action buttons it does not operate.

exceptions.because: no harness spec yet — keyboard passage between the hosted actions is unproven in browser; the spec lands with the interaction-evidence tranche
